name: KTM 950 / 990 Adventure
engine: 942 or 999 cc liquid-cooled LC8 V-twin, carbs (950) or fuel injected (990)
intro: KTM's first big LC8 adventure bikes. The 950 has carbs, the 990 is fuel injected. Twin fuel tanks and a lot of desert miles on most.

G: The 950 has carbs. The 990 is fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recallNote: KTM issued recall actions for the 990 Adventure and the 990 Adventure ABS. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or ask a KTM dealer.

known.title: KTM recall actions
known.what: KTM lists recall actions for the 990 Adventure and the 990 Adventure ABS on its safety page.
